summary: Gamification medal for the community: a hexagonal or circular medallion with the tier's icon and color (bronze, silver, gold, platinum, brand), a title, a localized earned date, or a locked state with progress.
whenToUse: Showing achievements earned on a member's profile (“First talk”, “Top contributor”).
Listing badges still to unlock, with progress toward the goal.
Celebrating a just-reached achievement on a page or in a dialog.
whenNotToUse: Status labels or short categories: use Badge.
Counts or dots on avatars and icons: use IndicatorBadge.
Rankings with positions and scores: use Leaderboard or RankingCard.
Progress toward a numeric goal in a dashboard: use GoalCard.

props.name: tier
props.description: Medal tier and color; brand uses the accent gradient and has no default name.

props.name: tierLabel
props.description: Overrides the localized tier name (required to show it with the brand tier).

props.name: earnedAt
props.description: Date earned, shown as “Earned on …” via Intl.DateTimeFormat; ignored when locked.

props.name: isLocked
props.description: Not yet earned: grayscale medal, padlock and “Locked” text.

props.name: progress
props.description: Progress toward a locked achievement (Progress bar with a “6 / 10” value).

props.name: shape
props.description: Medallion shape; in forced-colors mode it always becomes a circle.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the medallion and title.

props.name: layout
props.description: Medal above centered text, or beside it.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: When set, the title becomes a heading of that level.

props.name: AchievementBadgeGroup.minItemWidth
props.description: Minimum column width of the <ul> grid that wraps each badge in an <li>.

accessibility: The medallion is decorative (aria-hidden): title, tier, locked state and date are visible, localized text.
The tier is a Badge with text (“Gold”), not conveyed by color alone; the locked state is spelled out (“Locked”) in addition to the grayscale.
The progress bar is a Progress (role="progressbar") named by the title, with a “6 / 10” text value.
AchievementBadgeGroup is a <ul> list: give it an aria-label (“Earned badges”).
In forced-colors mode the medallion becomes a circle with a system border (dashed when locked).
responsive: AchievementBadgeGroup uses an auto-fill grid with minItemWidth: columns shrink in narrow containers.
The inline layout suits profile sidebars; stacked suits grids and celebrations.
customization: Tokens: --dc-gradient-accent-sheen (brand); metal tiers are derived with color-mix from --dc-color-feedback-warning (bronze, gold), --dc-color-border-strong/--dc-color-text-muted (silver), --dc-color-feedback-info-border/--dc-color-data-6 (platinum).
commonMistakes: Using a meaningful icon without a title: the medallion is decorative, the meaning lives in the text.
Passing dates as ambiguous strings (“12/03/2026”): use Date or ISO 8601.
Showing progress on an already earned badge: it is ignored and only works with isLocked.

examples.name: Tiers
examples.title: Tiers
examples.description: Bronze, silver, gold, platinum and brand with a custom name.

limits: There are no dedicated metal tokens: gold, silver, bronze and platinum are derived from semantic colors and change with the theme.
The brand tier has no localized name: use tierLabel to show one.
